messages.text: The Lantern Festival begins at 19:00 UTC in Amber Square.
Volunteers placed 40 lanterns around Amber Square.
Pax will open the east entrance.
Bring empty jars to the return table.

main_story.headline: Coordinating Details for the Lantern Festival Amid Access Point Planning
main_story.lede: Discussions among local coordinators focused on finalizing logistical details for the forthcoming *Lantern Festival* in Amber Square, covering everything from opening times to mandated entrance access and material collection.
main_story.body:
Preparations for the *Lantern Festival* commenced with clear notices regarding the event schedule. According to **Nora**, the festivities are set to begin at 19:00 UTC within *Amber Square*.

The physical setup of the square is progressing, with confirmation that volunteers have placed 40 lanterns around the perimeter. This coordination included establishing strict access guidelines for the area.

Specific roles concerning entry points were defined: **Nora** confirmed that **Pax** is assigned to opening the east entrance, while **Oren** stated explicitly that "The west entrance stays closed," ensuring controlled flow into the main event space.

Furthermore, coordination efforts addressed necessary materials for participants. **Nora** advised attendees of a specific requirement, instructing them to "Bring empty jars to the return table." This systematic planning suggests meticulous attention to maintaining order and functionality during the major community gathering.

announcements.title: Lantern Placement Milestone Reached
announcements.summary: **Oren** reported that volunteers successfully placed 40 lanterns around Amber Square. This effort marks a significant step in preparations for the upcoming festival.

announcements.title: East Entrance Access Confirmed
announcements.summary: According to **Nora**, plans dictate that *Pax* will be responsible for opening the east entrance, establishing managed access points for the region.
